title: The Aquafaba Experience
content:
### Everything you always wanted to know about aquafaba...

(*But were afraid to ask)

See below for slides and other materials from the aquafaba whipping demo and information session I presented to the Baking Experience group. I dove deep. Excessive. Plus: science. Sorry I can’t give you a can of chickpeas through the screen, too, but [send me an email](mailto:db@chom.ps) and I’ll see what I can do. ***Slides*** The two decks below cover 1) the technique and the full substitution landscape, and 2) the molecular architecture of why any of this works. ***Videos*** - [Aquafaba 101](https://youtu.be/ZRZ1jM7-kXI): Ultimate Guide to Nutrition, Recipes, Hacks, and Uses - [What Is Aquafaba?](https://youtu.be/kz7mKOMgJFg) (Also: How to use it as a vegan egg replacement and how to make vegan stiff peaks) ***Recipes*** - [Matcha Amaretti, egg whites](https://chom.ps/recipe?slug=matcha-amaretti) - [Matcha Amaretti, aquafaba](https://chom.ps/recipe?slug=matcha-amaretti-aquafaba) ***Handout*** Everybody came to the presentation for the cookie handout. I gave them a real one.
